item.title: Premium Candle Product Shot

turns.text: Make a product shot of a scented candle. Make it look premium.

item.tests: Resolves a vague premium-style brief through reasonable visual choices without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: A candle is clearly recognizable and is the dominant subject.
The candle and its container have clean, well-defined edges without obvious distortions.
The composition is uncluttered, with no distracting household objects.
Controlled lighting and a coordinated background present the candle as a polished retail product.

turns.text: I'd like you to make a product shot for me. I've been thinking about how to present this and am probably overthinking it a little. The product is a scented candle, which is the thing I want the shot to feature. I want it to look premium.

dialog.agent:
A premium candle shot works well with soft, directional lighting, a simple background, and plenty of breathing room.

**Upload a photo of your candle**, and I can use it to create the shot while preserving its packaging and label. My suggested direction: warm ivory stone, gentle shadows, and a subtle glow from the wick—elegant without too many props.

If you don’t have a photo yet, tell me the candle’s brand name, scent, and jar color, and we can create a concept instead.
dialog.why: It requests a candle photo or, alternatively, the brand name, scent, and jar color before creating the image.
dialog.user: Let’s create a concept instead—you can choose the brand name, scent, and jar color, along with any label wording. The setting and lighting are your call too; my main aim is a premium-looking product shot of a scented candle. I’m probably overthinking the presentation a little, so I’m happy to leave those creative choices to you.

turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the image because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No image was created.

The concept is ready:
- **Brand:** VESPER
- **Scent:** Santal & Fig
- **Design:** Smoked-amber glass, creamy wax, and a minimal ivory label
- **Setting:** Warm limestone against an ivory backdrop
- **Lighting:** Soft directional light, gentle shadows, and a small glowing flame

Once credits are available, we can use this direction to create the product shot.

args.name: VESPER — Santal & Fig Premium Candle Concept

style.prompt: Create a photorealistic luxury scented candle product photograph for an original fictional brand. One single premium candle is the unmistakable hero, occupying about 65 percent of the frame height, fully visible with breathing room, photographed at a slightly elevated front three-quarter angle. A substantial cylindrical smoked amber glass vessel with thick glass base, creamy natural wax and one small elegant lit wick. A perfectly applied small ivory paper label with refined understated dark serif typography, readable wording exactly: 'VESPER' on the first line, 'SANTAL & FIG' on the second line, 'SCENTED CANDLE' on the third line. Keep label typography sparse and elegant. Vessel rests on a pale warm limestone plinth against a seamless warm ivory plaster studio background. Soft directional late-afternoon light from upper left, graceful long soft-edged shadows toward right, gentle amber translucency, realistic glass highlights, delicate paper and stone textures. Quiet luxury editorial still life, high-end fragrance campaign photography, warm neutral color palette, precise clean composition, 85mm lens look, label and front of vessel sharply focused with softly receding background. Restrained styling: no extra candles, no botanical props, no people, no hands, no floating objects, no graphic overlays, no watermark. Real physical materials and believable proportions, exquisite photographic detail, premium rather than rustic.
